ALGER, 19 juillet 2026 (Algéria Tech) —: ALGIERS, July 19, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algeria becomes a founding member of the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO), marking its entry into the global governance of artificial intelligence. This membership underlines the growing role of the country in international technological and diplomatic issues.
L'Algérie s'est jointe aux 29 membres fo: Algeria joined the 29 founding members of WAICO, an intergovernmental organization created in Shanghai. This structure aims to supervise multilateral cooperation in artificial intelligence, a rapidly expanding field. Algerian membership is part of a global context marked by several competing initiatives, such as the Summit for Action on AI in Paris (February 2025), the Global Partnership on AI (GPAI) or the European regulation on AI (AI Act). WAICO, supported by China, offers an alternative to structure international trade in this sector.
Cette participation place l'Algérie au c: This participation places Algeria at the heart of debates on the regulation of AI, a major economic issue. According to McKinsey, artificial intelligence could generate up to four thousand four hundred billion dollars in annual added value by 2030 on a global scale. For a country like Algeria, whose economy is partly based on hydrocarbons, the integration of these technologies becomes an imperative to diversify activities and strengthen digital sovereignty.
Parmi les 29 membres fondateurs de la WA: Among the 29 founding members of WAICO, Algeria occupies a unique position. It is the only North African country to be part of it and one of only two Arab states, alongside Oman. This presence is not accidental: it reflects an active technological diplomacy, relying on the country's traditional networks, notably Africa and the Arab world, while expanding its partnerships, notably with China.
Cette adhésion révèle également le rôle: This accession also reveals the often underestimated geopolitical role of Algeria. The country is a key player in three strategic spaces: Africa, where it is a founding member of the African Union and mediator in several crises; the Arab world, via the Arab League and its diplomatic positions; and the Global South, a group of developing countries sharing common interests in the face of Western powers.
Rejoindre la WAICO permet à l'Algérie de: Joining WAICO allows Algeria to pursue several simultaneous objectives. First, strengthen its digital sovereignty by participating in the development of international standards, thus avoiding being subject to rules imposed by other actors. Next, position yourself in the global AI ecosystem to access technology partnerships, knowledge flows and investments. Finally, assert its diplomatic influence by ensuring an institutional presence in an area that will shape the balance of power in the 21st century.
Le positionnement de l'Algérie dans ce s: Algeria's positioning in this sector is not a simple declaration of intent. This is a concrete strategy aimed at preparing the country for future economic and security challenges. While the major technological powers (United States, China, European Union) compete for hegemony in this area, Algeria chooses to actively engage rather than stay behind.
